readme: Dated policy events that affect held or targeted names. Maintained by the weekly research agent (PRODUCER.md step 7) and by the owner — NOT fetched, because no free structured feed exists for this and a wrong date would defer or wave through a real trade. Ships empty on purpose: an empty calendar makes every policy helper a no-op, which is the correct failure mode. See producer/policy.mjs for the schema and validatePolicy() for the rules. Only impact:'high' events can defer a buy, and those require a source URL.

schema.title: short human label (required)
schema.kind: tariff | fda | appropriations | antitrust | regulatory | election | other
schema.impact: high | medium | low — only 'high' defers a buy (required)
sectors: broader exposure, matched against a name's sector
schema.note: why this matters for the position
schema.source: https://… — required for any high-impact event
